design.decision: Every time you have the lead, choose between cashing a winner and leading low for ×1.2 while giving the lead to the opponents; it rewards keeping low cards and winning in order to lead them.
design.opponent: Obvious after a few leads; opponents can duck low leads cheaply but must decide whether to take the lead back.
design.rationale: Lead triggers measured very strongly (e-lead-rank-2-xmult +19.9 at common), and leading low is real tension in Spades because it gives up control and the opponents can take the trick. A repeated ×mult at a small factor is the rare budget's 'broad' shape and is distinct from the uncommon milestone uc-low-lead-three-x.
design.draftText: ×1.2 contract multiplier when your team leads a [2] through [6]

critic.concerns: Leading low is often the natural play anyway, so it may fire on autopilot; per-event compounding is hard to track.
